facts.business: Goblin India Limited manufactures and sells luggage and travel gear including hard luggage, soft luggage, backpacks, handbags, and accessories, catering to both B2B corporate gifting and B2C retail channels across India and overseas.

segments.name: Hard luggage, office bags and backpacks
Other products (soft luggage, accessories, ladies' handbags and purses, duffle trolleys)

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (i) Company not providing GST electronic credit ledger, reconciliations and detailed GST payable workings for verification; (ii) Outstanding statutory liabilities under Income Tax Act, non-filing of Income Tax Return for AY 2025-26 and TDS returns for FY 2025-26 within timelines, unpaid TDS liabilities as at 31 March 2026, and no provision for interest/penalty or disclosure of contingent liabilities.

key_risks: Foreign currency risk (though stated as low due to less exposure to foreign revenue)
Statutory non-compliance risks: GST reconciliation issues, Income Tax return non-filing, TDS return delays and unpaid TDS liabilities
Dependence on luggage and travel gear market cycles
